chars.AHMED: AHMED: a slim young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.KARIM: KARIM: a young man wearing a red-and-black checkered flannel shirt over a white t-shirt and black cargo trousers
chars.RIHAB: RIHAB: a young woman wearing a lilac satin blouse, a long cream skirt and small gold hoop earrings
chars.STRANGER: STRANGER: a young man wearing a black leather jacket, a grey t-shirt and sunglasses pushed up on his head

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: At a cliffside seaside café terrace in Tangier, KARIM hides behind a white wall in the foreground, phone at his ear, eyes wide in shock, staring at RIHAB who sits in the background resting her head on the STRANGER's shoulder, both smiling. Tense, dramatic afternoon light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: AHMED stands in a busy office in Tangier holding his phone to his ear, frowning and confused, colleagues blurred in the background.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: AHMED on the phone in the office, smiling proudly and gesturing with his free hand as if saying 'she is my fiancée', warm light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: KARIM crouches behind a potted plant at the seaside café, whispering into his phone with a worried face; in the distance RIHAB laughs close to the STRANGER at a small table facing the sea.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of AHMED on the phone, face turning angry and shocked, jaw clenched, his free hand gripping his hoodie, office background.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: AHMED rushing out of the office building onto a Tangier street, phone at his ear, pleading urgently, other hand raised, people around him.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: AHMED sitting in the back of a blue Tangier petit taxi, leaning forward anxiously, the white city and the sea visible through the windows, motion blur outside.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: On the stepped terraces of an old seaside café overlooking the Strait of Gibraltar, RIHAB leans her head romantically on the STRANGER's shoulder, both looking at the sea, mint tea glasses on a small table, golden sunset.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: AHMED stands frozen at the top of the café steps in the foreground, seen from the side, hand on his chest, eyes wide in disbelief, looking down at RIHAB and the STRANGER sitting close together far below by the sea.
